fusions.name: Quarry Marked
fusions.desc: Fires an iron dart that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing the Gap
fusions.desc: Runs down an enemy up to 8 tiles away and strikes it for 14 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Jaws Underfoot
fusions.desc: Sets iron jaws beneath the nearest enemy. They wait up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 20 damage and is [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It draws the attention of your last target.

fusions.name: Never Lose the Scent
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises by 12%.
